name: @scomm-office/openpgp-pqc-vendor
description: Vendored, prebuilt copy of openpgpjs commit d35228cc0253c0d093989ff10232a750fd0b6489 (PQC/RFC 9980 support, no released npm version supports this yet). Prebuilt because installing this commit as a live git dependency reruns its `prepare` build from source, which is not reproducible (its own devDependencies resolve fresh from the registry with no lockfile, and at this exact commit src/index.js imports a src/enums.ts that does not exist upstream). This package ships only the already-built dist/ output so no build step ever runs again. To refresh: check out the desired openpgpjs commit, run `npm install` there once until it succeeds, then copy dist/ and lightweight/ from its node_modules/openpgp here.
